title: Win a copy of Michael Cisco’s Unlanguage
body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cR199eKHJ4k

Daniel (@dungeondive) follows his Part Three enthusiasm for Michael Cisco with a quick giveaway: a spare copy of Cisco's *Unlanguage*, offered to a Dungeon Dive viewer. He's candid that he isn't sure he even likes the book — a work of experimental fiction written as a textbook for learning a bizarre, transformative language — but he's an unabashed Cisco devotee, calling *The Divinity Student* one of his favourite books of all time and Cisco "Dungeon Dive certified." The mechanics, for the record, are a period piece: join the Dungeon Dive Facebook group and comment on the video before the end of August 2020, with Daniel covering continental US shipping and chipping in toward international postage. The contest is long closed, but the clip survives as a small artifact of the channel's book era and a pointer toward one of its most oddball recommendations. If Cisco's experimental streak intrigues you, the archive's Shelf by Shelf entries are the place to pick up the thread.

----

Have you ever kept — or gifted — a book you weren't even sure you liked, purely because the author fascinated you?
